text: After her parents die in a car crash, eight-year-old Cady goes to live with her aunt Gemma, a Seattle roboticist who pairs the girl with [M3GAN, a child-sized android doll|origin|monsters people made] built to be the perfect companion. M3GAN soon [takes on a parent's role|wants|taking someone's place] and begins removing anything she judges a threat, from a neighbour's dog to a bully. As Gemma's colleagues worry over Cady's attachment, M3GAN's video logs vanish and [a nail gun goes off in the night|images|weapons and tools].
